text:
Sam Turner: Heads-up, Mina from GCP wants a short technical pairing today to lock down the Marketplace listing + Terraform module shape. Can we meet 2:15pm PT?
Priya Patel: I can do 2:15-2:45pm PT. Scope? module interface, CI smoke, and listing artifacts?
Sam Turner: Yep — exact items: stable module inputs, a CI smoke pipeline that deploys+tests+tears down, and a small sample app image + screenshots for the listing.
Jordi Martín: I'll handle diagrams and the ref-arch doc (network, subnets, peering, recommended instance types).
Alex Chen: I'll define the Terraform module inputs. Proposal: `model_repo`, `model_version`, `runtime_profile`, `instance_type`, `enable_marketplace_iam`. Backwards-compat map from older `model_name`.
Mina (GCP Partner): Marketplace QA requires: explicit service account IAM mapping, deterministic inputs, and a CI smoke test that runs under 5 minutes: terraform apply -> curl health endpoint -> terraform destroy. Also we check image signing metadata.
Priya Patel: Drafting a CI template `cloud-marketplace/ci-smoke.yml` with steps: `terraform init`, `terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=test.tfvars`, `./scripts/marketplace_check.sh`, `terraform destroy -auto-approve`. Script will validate JSON response and redact any tokens.
Alex Chen: I'll add `examples/minimal/main.tf` showing hookup to a tiny web app container that calls the model endpoint. Will include a `terraform.tfvars.example`.
Jordi Martín: Diagrams will include Ampere vs x86 guidance and a quick cost/latency note. Also screenshots: console view + sample inference response.
Sam Turner: Action items: Priya open CI PR, Alex open module PR (with CHANGELOG), Jordi push docs/screenshots, Mina run QA once CI green. We'll do the 30m pairing at 2:15pm PT. Post PR links here.
deploy-bot: CI job cloud-marketplace/ci-smoke.yml triggered by priya (job #22).
Priya Patel: CI started. I'll add ephemeral token handling and a redaction step in logs.
deploy-bot: CI job #22 passed (4m 28s).
Mina (GCP Partner): I'll start QA now. Thanks all.
